title: Find Longest Special Substring That Occurs Thrice I
summary: Given a string s of lowercase English letters, find the length of the longest substring that is special (consisting of a single character) and appears at least three times, or return -1 if no such substring exists.
statement: Given a string s of lowercase English letters, find the length of the longest substring that is special (consisting of a single character) and appears at least three times, or return -1 if no such substring exists. A substring is a consecutive sequence of characters within s.
constraints: s has at least three lowercase letters.
A special substring contains repetitions of only one character, and overlapping occurrences count separately.
Return the greatest length occurring at least three times, or -1.
hints: A run of length r contains max(0,r-L+1) occurrences of a one-character substring of length L.
Collect run lengths per character and test candidate lengths by summing their occurrence contributions.
For each character and L through its largest run, sum max(0,run-L+1); retain L when the sum is at least three.
Every special occurrence lies wholly in exactly one same-character run, so the run formula counts all starts exactly once, including overlaps.
editorial: Every special occurrence lies wholly in exactly one same-character run, so the run formula counts all starts exactly once, including overlaps.
